headword: {集合写真|しゅうごうしゃしん}

definitions.explanation: A photograph of a group of people gathered and posed together, as at a school event, wedding, or company outing.

examples.japanese: {集合写真|しゅうごうしゃしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{集合写真|しゅうごうしゃしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: We took a group photo after the graduation ceremony.
In group photos, the tall people usually stand in the back row.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {集合写真|しゅうごうしゃしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧ (to take a group photo)
- {集合写真|しゅうごうしゃしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{写|うつ}る→写る：11494_utsuru⟧ (to appear in a group photo)
- ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦アルバム→アルバム：03831_arubamu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{集合写真|しゅうごうしゃしん} (the class photo in a yearbook)

CULTURAL NOTE:
School trips, graduations, and weddings in Japan almost always end with a formal {集合写真|しゅうごうしゃしん}, often taken by a hired photographer; a classmate absent that day may be shown in a small inset circle in the corner.
